description: This file contains selectors and utility functions for onboarding steps, preferences, and UI state management in the Mattermost web application, specifically related to onboarding tasks, user roles, and legacy onboarding logic.

classes.name: StepType
classes.description: Type defining the structure of onboarding steps, including an ID and associated roles.

methods.name: getFirstChannelName
methods.description: Retrieves the name of the first channel from preferences.

methods.name: getShowLaunchingWorkspace
methods.description: Returns whether the 'launching workspace' modal should be shown.

methods.name: isStepForUser
methods.description: Determines if a given onboarding step is applicable for the current user's roles.

methods.name: getSteps
methods.description: Selector that filters onboarding steps based on current user roles and admin status.

methods.name: getNextStepsPreferences
methods.description: Selector for retrieving preferences related to recommended next steps.

methods.name: getOnboardingTaskPreferences
methods.description: Selector for retrieving onboarding task category preferences.

methods.name: legacyNextStepsNotFinished
methods.description: Selector that checks if legacy onboarding steps are not yet completed or skipped.

methods.name: hasLegacyNextStepsPreferences
methods.description: Selector that verifies if legacy next steps preferences are set.

methods.name: getShowTaskListBool
methods.description: Determines whether to show the onboarding task list based on preferences, user state, and device type.
